title: Silent Fallthrough Bug
description: Adding a new node type without adding its case to the match statement causes the entire subtree to vanish silently, not raise an error.

steps.description: Reveal node classes: Num, Var, BinOp from before, plus new Call node.
Reveal pretty: match statement with cases for Num, Var, BinOp, and catch-all _ case.
Reveal tree: BinOp with a Call node containing Num, BinOp, and Var children.

steps.question: What does pretty print for the Call node without its case?
steps.answer: Unknown: Call(...) with no recursion into children

steps.description: Reveal demonstration: prints tree, shows Unknown line, and explains the silent truncation.
Focus on BinOp case: recurses on left and right children.
Focus on missing case: TODO comment where Call arm should be.
Focus on catch-all: _ case prints Unknown without recursing, losing the subtree.
Run to show the tree with Call printed as Unknown.
